description: CI's Linux shards and `make linux-ci`, inside the podman devcontainer, classified from CI run 36898564273 on cf28fe7 (2026-10-01): the unit shard skips 3,108 and the btrc shard 34; the corpus, bootstrap and eight strict-C11 shards skip none. About 2,950 are macOS-only native interop. Rules marked 'Delete this rule once stage4/tools-ci ...' expire when that lane's dev-shell tools land (lldb, pugixml, sqlite, BTRC_NATIVE_PROVIDER_CC/CXX). Every covered_by macOS claim was checked against macOS run 36898564246's unit and btrc reports, and again (as macos-hosted) against macOS run 37110991739 in Stage 38. Every shard runs under tools/virtual-display.sh (Xvfb and Mesa lavapipe), so the Linux GUI and GPU compute-adapter tests run and their skips are no longer expected. Its macOS coverage names macos-hosted, the runner macos.yml reports as since Stage 38 (CL-R-36), so every claim is checked against hosted reports on each push; the acceptance Mac runs a superset.

rules.reason: ^requires macOS and the explicitly built native header reader$
rules.note: Native imports of Apple SDK headers (AppKit, Foundation, CoreFoundation, Objective-C and C++ owners, callbacks, realtime, resources) need macOS and its SDK; the macOS unit and btrc shards build the reader and run these.

rules.reason: ^native SHA requires macOS and the configured SDK reader$
rules.note: The SDK-backed artifact digest provider is composed only by cli/MacOSMain.btrc; macos.yml's btrc shard runs it.
Reads the real Apple SDK headers, which exist only on macOS.
Links and runs emitted Objective-C against Foundation.
Runs a real AppKit application loop.
CoreAudio exists only on macOS; Linux audio runs through the ALSA cases of test_native_linux_providers.py.
ImageIO exists only on macOS; Linux image decoding runs in test_native_linux_providers.py.

rules.reason: ^actual SDK compiler qualification runs on macOS$
rules.note: Compiles emitted C++ with the Apple SDK compiler.

rules.reason: ^Darwin executable debug maps reference object files$
rules.note: Mach-O debug maps; ELF executables embed their DWARF instead.
ld64's -dependency_info receipts have no GNU ld equivalent.
Interposes posix_spawn through Mach-O dyld.

rules.reason: ^this reader/runtime has no qualified persistent-cache provider$
rules.note: Only the macOS reader/runtime is admitted as an immutable persistent-cache provider; BTRC_NATIVE_CACHE_REQUIRED=1 turns this skip into a failure where one is required.
Resolves Apple's lldb through xcrun.

The Linux dev shell carries no lldb: nixpkgs' Linux lldb is built for python3.13 while the debug adapter probes the shell's python3 (3.14), so stage4/tools-ci left it out. macos.yml's unit shard enables developer mode and runs these four DAP sessions (run 36934014516).

The Linux dev shell carries no pugixml; only the Darwin shells add it, for the macOS-only C++ owner proofs. The Darwin dev shells carry it since stage4/tools-ci (88a5c36), and macOS run 36934014516 ran every case this rule explains.

rules.reason: ^build native reader and configure its native compiler provider$
rules.note: The header reader implements a native compiler provider only on Apple hosts (tools/NativeHeaderReader.cpp refuses with unsupported-compiler-provider elsewhere), so only the Darwin dev shells export BTRC_NATIVE_PROVIDER_CC/CXX; exported here, these skips would become failures. macOS run 36934014516 ran every case this rule explains.

rules.reason: ^configure the packaged receipt provider and its C/C\+\+ toolchain$
rules.note: The header reader implements a native compiler provider only on Apple hosts (tools/NativeHeaderReader.cpp refuses with unsupported-compiler-provider elsewhere), so only the Darwin dev shells export BTRC_NATIVE_PROVIDER_CC/CXX; exported here, these skips would become failures. macOS run 36934014516 ran every case this rule explains.

rules.reason: ^native tray backend is unavailable: (no session bus|org\.kde\.StatusNotifierWatcher is not on the session bus)
rules.note: No runner hosts a StatusNotifierItem watcher. tools/virtual-display.sh runs CI's shards inside tools/ui/headless-session.sh, whose private session bus has no watcher on it; a shell without a session bus has no bus at all. No other runner runs the Linux tray backend.
windows.yml runs test_artifact_storage.py on a native Windows host.
windows.yml runs test_generation_validator_matches_native_windows_staging_modes.
windows.yml runs test_bootstrap_harness.py before its native bootstrap.
windows.yml runs test_artifact_reparse.py beside test_artifact_storage.py.

rules.reason: ^(native bindings need the native header reader|self-hosted artifact reuse needs the native header reader identity)$
rules.note: C4's P2 and P3-binding program checks compile a native binding, and the btrcc module-unit cache cases need the reader's identity to reuse artifacts; the Linux dev shell does not export the reader, and macos.yml's btrc shard builds and exports it (CL-C-06).
